title: DataPortability
description: ISO 25012-sourced data quality archetype — Portability system-dependent data quality characteristic. The degree to which data has attributes that enable it to be installed, replaced, or moved from one system to another preserving the existing quality in a specific context of use. Rootless archetype — used as qualifier in Directives/Norms governing data entities. Source: ISO/IEC 25012 (System-Dependent Data Quality — Portability).

portabilityLevel.description: Degree of data portability. LOCKED_IN = proprietary format, vendor-specific. EXPORTABLE = can be exported but with transformation needed. STANDARD_FORMAT = uses industry-standard formats. FULLY_PORTABLE = self-describing, platform-independent, no transformation needed.

standardFormats.description: Standard data formats supported for portability (e.g., CSV, JSON, Parquet, Avro, XML).

migrationComplexity.description: Expected complexity of migrating data between systems.
